name: adapt-grow-show_working
description: Show your working — a step-by-step worked solution where each line arrives in turn with the move annotated and the answer checked by substitution.

extra.info: A worked solution revealed one line at a time: each step rises in with a hand-written annotation of the move, and the final answer is checked by substitution with a tick that draws on. Paced by the theme motion knob, quiet under reduced motion, and screen-reader readable at rest.
